# Getting help

- **Setup, PBX quirks, "is this expected?"** — [Discussions](https://github.com/5060-Solutions/aria/discussions).
- **Something is broken** — [open a bug report](https://github.com/5060-Solutions/aria/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include the SIP trace from **Settings → Diagnostics**; it answers most questions on its own.
- **Security problem** — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Please do not open a public issue.
- **Commercial use and support** — Aria is free for non-commercial use. For a commercial license or supported deployment, write to sales@5060solutions.com.
- **Downloads and release notes** — [aria-softphone.com](https://aria-softphone.com) and the [releases page](https://github.com/5060-Solutions/aria/releases).
